subject: 辽金北方（11–13世纪）·带栏木桥（原创扩展；匿名年代意象，非文物复原）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Make ONE isolated complete wooden bridge as a production TRANSPARENT game tile, on totally clear RGBA background. OBJECT ITSELF MUST BE FULLY OPAQUE alpha255; background alpha0; absolutely NO atmospheric glow, blurred backdrop, fog, gradients or scenery. Style: realistic ancient northern Chinese Liao/Jin wooden town bridge, weathered desaturated pale brown wood with subtle fine grain, plain construction, roughly 11th-13th centuries original game design. ONLY a BROAD SHORT rectangular timber beam deck with simple low twin horizontal wooden rails on its two long sides, three square posts on each side, 8 cross-planks. Empty short ends remain fully open and visible. CRITICAL GEOMETRY: Bridge physical rectangle WIDTH3 LENGTH5, WIDTH=60% of LENGTH. This is near-square broad platform, NOT long narrow footbridge. Flat deck in true 2:1 game dimetric projection; 45 degree azimuth, 30 degree elevation, parallel orthographic projection; every long edge goes RIGHT-UP at EXACT slope -0.5; every short edge goes RIGHT-DOWN at EXACT slope +0.5, about26.565degrees from horizontal, NOT steeper standard isometric30degree ground diagonals. On the landscape1536x1024 canvas, deck outer vertices should be LEFT(180,560), FRONT(630,785), RIGHT(1380,410), BACK(930,185). The near short edge's horizontal run450 must be SIX-TENTHS the right long edge's horizontal run750. These are invisible production geometry instructions; don't depict coordinates, diagram, outline, grid or dimensions. Render realistic timber texture onto that EXACT broad parallelogram. Low side rails so deck corners remain evident; tiny timber feet, 40pixel deck thickness. Light upper-left and slight lower-right contact shadow contained by object. No stonework, vegetation, land island, water, banks, bridge house, canopy, ornament, ropes, metal, figures, text or watermark. Entire object centered comfortably with clear margins. No perspectival convergence. No fake painted transparency.
negative: 无字、无人、无现代物、无背景、无厚地台、无假棋盘透明、无透视汇聚
created_time_basis: 源PNG文件mtime；非服务端回执时间

geometry_qa.measurement_note: 同高桥面四角实测；四角均值作锚，前边比及对边平均比均登记，桥墩/水面高差待装配。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize with integer rounding
transparent padding; no alpha threshold, warp, painting or stretching

notes: 第4次运行选第2候选；旧源图及repair2/3保留为历史。外占地/实际源测点与剩余局部误差见geometry_qa；仅裁切、等比缩放与扩边，保持原alpha。桥面前边比误差4.56%、对边平均比误差6.58%，双前轴+0.549/-0.560仍略陡；含栏静态候选，前栏遮挡与岸面高差待联调。
